summary.title: Learn to build your own desktop chat app with React and Electron, one step at a time
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a desktop chat app with React and Electron, using Chatkit for realtime messaging and a "who's online" list, step by step.
takeaways: Set up an Electron starter template and run a React app inside a desktop window
Create users and rooms on a small Express server using the Chatkit server SDK
Subscribe to room messages in realtime and send messages from a React form
Show an online-users list that updates automatically through Chatkit callbacks
Try bonus challenges: typing indicators and user-created rooms
summary.summary: This freeCodeCamp-hosted tutorial by Alex Booker walks through building a complete desktop chat application with Electron and React, in numbered steps. It starts from a starter template, sets up a Chatkit instance and a small Node/Express server that creates users, then adds a username form, a chat screen, realtime message subscription, message sending, styling, and an online-users list. Code snippets are pasted at each step, and the page ends with two bonus challenges and ideas for extensions. The tutorial relies on Chatkit as the backend, so the code is tied to that service.
